issue.title: Complete remaining Reflex 0.10 auth compatibility
issue.body:
Found while validating #243 against Reflex `main`. These eight failures also reproduce with the original production code (only the scope-restoration fixture was adapted so the tests could run), and are outside the backend-variable compatibility change.

Track and fix the remaining auth migration work separately:

- `tests/units/auth/test_cookie.py::test_get_skip_vars_cookie_inheritance_hierarchy`: Reflex `main` removes `get_skip_vars`.
- Cookie synchronization failures in `test_sync_cookies_from_browser`, `test_sync_cookies_to_browser`, `test_sync_cookies_partitioned`, `test_sync_cookies_bidirectional`, and `test_sync_cookies_browser_reset`. Browser cookie values are not synchronized, and expected Set-Cookie headers are absent.
- `tests/units/auth/test_cookie.py::test_var_dependencies_with_http_cookie`: the cookie dependency is absent from the parent's `_var_dependencies`.
- `tests/units/auth/test_enforcement.py::test_rxe_wrappers_without_explicit_auth_are_protected_by_sweep`: `RxeDefaultState.base_vars["data"]` raises `KeyError`.

Reproduce with Reflex and reflex-base installed from current Reflex `main`:

```shell
python -m pytest tests/units/auth/test_cookie.py tests/units/auth/test_enforcement.py -q
```

Keep these changes in a separate PR, with coverage on supported 0.9.x versions as well as Reflex `main`.
